title: daphne sericea subsp. pseudosericea

It is a small, woody shrub native to the Himalayan region, used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Daphne pseudosericea include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of Daphne pseudosericea include terpenoids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
